description: Gujarat will establish 37 Data & AI Labs under the Centre's IndiaAI Mission, including 20 ITIs and 17 Polytechnics, to strengthen AI education and workforce development. The state has also received two AI Centres of Excellence, 23 AI research fellowships, and subsidised GPU computing access to boost AI innovation, startups, research, and industry-ready skills.
body_lead: Ahmedabad: Thirty-seven technical education institutes in Gujarat have been identified for the establishment of Data & AI Labs under the Centre's 'IndiaAI Mission', with 20 Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) and 17 Polytechnics selected to strengthen artificial intelligence education and workforce development in the state. The information was provided by Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology, Jitin Prasada, in a written reply to questions on artificial intelligence raised by Rajya Sabha MP Parimal Nathwani.
